assumptions: Requirements were taken from the screenshots and screen intent (operator correction); UI code and demo arrays were read only to learn which kinds of things exist.
The Data, Compute and Agents panels were reached only as entries in the + Panel menu and through research file 10; their internals are design intent at menu-note depth.
The pod simulator's measures (luck share, steps in, noise band) are defined here from what the cards show; the formulas are the template's scripts, not spine values.
Deflated Sharpe over every family trial is [remembered]; the spine binds only that every trial counts.
The day-one kernel adapter is a python -I subprocess under the engine's script envelope until the environment study picks the sandbox (ruling 53).
open_questions: OPEN-1 pod composition now: Book+BMS adapter with named unsupported blocks (recommended) vs wait for the risk session
OPEN-2 paper money in v1: server paper ledger on live prices (recommended); broker demo and testnet through the node later
OPEN-3 who starts a paper run: the operator's MANAGE yes (recommended) vs the Lab rule
OPEN-4 a mix is a pod with members and a split-across-pods allocator (recommended) vs a separate kind
OPEN-5 Lab-scoped schedules under one standing allow rule (recommended) vs MANAGE per schedule
OPEN-6 pairs in the scenario builder: defer until QMB has a spread instrument (recommended) vs cut
conflicts_with_prior_decisions: Library spine AD-3 maps book-definition -> pod and bms-definition -> pod-block; the screens' pod is a stack of blocks across seven slots and a pod block is one pure rule, so this design reads the mirrors as two added governed kinds `book` and `bms` and keeps `pod` / `pod-block` as ungoverned design kinds (schema-file addition under library AD-3). The Library agent must ratify or reject.

DEC-0261 / DEC-0275 say the node runs no per-bot paper lane and QMA-paper does not exist; this design adds a Lab paper run outside the node (an engine run on a paper ledger over live prices), which is neither, and routes demo-account paper through the node later (ruling 29 vs TN-9).
qmx_tools run_backtest(config_ref) and the pre-registered-config door retire in favour of qmb.compile + the qmb node pack (AD-5).
